 Designation
 Trimmed size

 P. 297 × 420 
 
 

 B. A1
 Q. 420× 594

 R. 594 × 841

options.text: A - S, B - R, C - Q, D - P
A - R, B - S, C - Q, D - P
A - S, B - R, C - P, D - Q

solution:
__**E×planation:**__

The correct option for matching the designation of the trimmed sizes of sheets is:

**Option 1:** A - S, B - R, C - Q, D - P

This option correctly matches the designation of sheets with their respective trimmed sizes:

 
• **A0:** 841 × 1189
 
• **A1:** 594 × 841
 
• **A2:** 420 × 594
 
• **A3:** 297 × 420

The sizes of sheets in the ISO A series paper standard are derived from the A0 size. The A0 sheet has an area of 1 square meter, and its dimensions are such that the width-to-height ratio is the square root of 2 (appro×imately 1.414). This ratio ensures that when the sheet is divided into two equal parts parallel to its shorter side, the resulting sheets retain the same width-to-height ratio.

The trimmed sizes of sheets decrease progressively as follows:

 
• **A0:** 841 × 1189 mm
 
• **A1:** 594 × 841 mm
 
• **A2:** 420 × 594 mm
 
• **A3:** 297 × 420 mm
